cues: The third tool is a vector, a carrier that will multiply inside the host.
The classic one is the plasmid p B R three two two: a small ring of bacterial DNA.
It has an origin of replication, so it copies itself, and two antibiotic resistance genes, for ampicillin and tetracycline, that act as markers.
